purpose: Large data file containing all mapped vehicle variant records. Instructions are intentionally split into validation_instructions_by_id_v1.json to keep each file below upload limits and force two-file lookup.

source_file.description: Clean manually merged resume package: previous 258-variant accumulated dataset + latest RS5 resume additions; continues from Audi RS6.

standard.standard_basis: latest_flat_engine records in partial_variants; core latest fields only, excluding sporadic metadata fields such as updated_at
standard.id_rule: validation_id is deterministic after sorting by make, model, year_start, year_end, generation, engine, transmission, body_type, trim, variant_id. It does not replace variant_id.

mapping_rules.aliases -> alternate_names: Legacy aliases are copied into latest alternate_names.
mapping_rules.market -> market_scope: Legacy market is copied into market_scope when market_scope is absent.
mapping_rules.nested_field.value -> flat field: Legacy per-field envelope objects are flattened by using their value property.
mapping_rules.nested_field.source_ids -> field_sources: Legacy per-field source IDs are collected into field_sources and source_ids.
mapping_rules.confidence/verification_status -> confid: Legacy confidence is used as confidence_level where latest confidence_level is absent.
mapping_rules.identity_confidence/verification_status: Legacy identity confidence/status is used as closest available market_name_confidence signal.
mapping_rules.official_marketed_name_il/local_brand_na: Left null for legacy records when no direct original field exists; not fabricated.

validation_readiness.recommended_next_step: Run a stratified AI validation sample before full batch: high priority duplicates/critical gaps first, then medium naming/spec gaps, then low deterministic fields.
validation_readiness.do_not_overwrite_rule: AI outputs should be stored in a separate validation_result object/table; standard_variant and original_snapshot should remain unchanged until canonical merge approval.
